_source.note: make iam-request-resources-check re-derives every operation's resources from botocore; make iam-request-resources-verify checks every action, type and format against AWS.

notCovered.autoscaling: not read yet: AWS's group and launch configuration ARNs carry an id the service mints, `autoScalingGroup:<id>:autoScalingGroupName/<name>`, while Floci mints `autoScalingGroup:<name>`, which other services (ECS capacity providers) read back; the mint is fixed first

notCovered.cloudhsm: not read yet: its ARN formats end in ${CloudHsmClusterInstanceName} and ${CloudHsmBackupInstanceName}, names, while its requests give ClusterId and BackupId, ids, which the rules do not fill a name from, so nearly every operation's resource would be left open
notCovered.codedeploy: not read yet: the Service Reference gives an on-premises instance's ARN as `instance:${InstanceName}`, while the CodeDeploy permissions reference gives arn:aws:codedeploy:region:account-id:instance/instance-ID and AWS's GetOnPremisesInstance example answers instance/<name>_<id>, an id the service mints after the name; reading it needs that format corrected

notCovered.swf: not read yet: the Service Reference gives a domain's ARN no Region, `swf::<account>:/domain/<name>`, while the SWF Developer Guide gives it as arn:aws:swf:Region:AccountID:/domain/DomainName, as Floci mints it; reading it needs that format corrected
notCovered.verifiedpermissions: not read yet: a policyStoreId may name its store by an alias, `policy-store-alias/<name>`, which AWS authorizes as the action on the store the alias points to and GetPolicyStoreAlias on the alias, and an aliasName carries the `policy-store-alias/` its format already gives; reading it needs both
